translationRepairs: Empress Wu exploited the weakness of the High and Middle Emperors to seize imperial power. Fearing dissent below and seeking to intimidate the court, she cut down branches of the imperial family, and so encouraged secret denunciations and engineered sweeping prosecutions.

Empress Wu exploited the weakness of Gaozong and Zhongzong to seize imperial power. Fearing dissent below and seeking to intimidate the court, she cut down branches of the imperial family, and so encouraged secret denunciations and engineered sweeping prosecutions.
高、中 are the emperors Gaozong and Zhongzong.

In the Zaichu era, Right Censor Zhou Ju admonished the Empress: "Malicious accusers have made denunciation commonplace. Investigating officers treat harsh coercion and venomous slander as achievement — inventing crimes from nothing, vying in cruelty, sealing ears in mud, caging heads, combining cangues and wedges with brutality, pulling ribs and tearing nails, suspending hair and smoking eyes — all under the name 'Prison Restraint.

In the Zaichu era, Right Tribunal Censor Zhou Ju admonished the Empress: "Malicious accusers have made denunciation commonplace. Investigating officers treat harsh coercion and venomous slander as achievement — inventing crimes from nothing, vying in cruelty, sealing ears in mud, caging heads, combining cangues and wedges with brutality, pulling ribs and tearing nails, suspending hair and smoking eyes — all under the name 'Prison Restraint.
右臺御史 is a censor of the Right Tribunal.
Yuanli sensed her wishes, immediately memorialized reporting urgent treason, was summoned for audience, promoted to General of Irregular Command, and appointed investigating commissioner.
Yuanli sensed her wishes, immediately memorialized reporting urgent treason, was summoned for audience, promoted to Mobile Corps General, and appointed investigating commissioner.
遊擊將軍 is the Mobile Corps General rank.
He turned the Luoyang prefectural prison into a special interrogation house, fitted an iron cage over the head, and drove in wedges until the skull split and the prisoner died.
He turned the Luozhou governor’s compound into a special interrogation house, fitted an iron cage over the head, and drove in wedges until the skull split and the prisoner died.
洛州牧院 is the Luozhou governor’s compound.
Ben owed gambling debts of several hundred thousand cash and could not repay them; Cao took his wife — she was already pregnant and bore Junchen, who was passed off under Ben's surname.
Ben owed gambling debts of several hundred thousand cash and could not repay them; Cao took his wife — she was already pregnant and bore Junchen, who took Cao's surname, Lai.
冒其姓: Junchen took his stepfather Cao’s surname.

While traveling in Hezhou he turned to robbery, was captured and jailed, and filed a secret accusation from prison. Prefect Dongping Wang Xu investigated, found no basis for it, and had him flogged a hundred strokes.

While traveling in Hezhou he turned to robbery, was captured and jailed, and filed a secret accusation from prison. Prefect Xu, Prince of Dongping, investigated, found no basis for it, and had him flogged a hundred strokes.
東平王續 is Li Xu, Prince of Dongping, not a man surnamed Wang.
In the Tianshou era Xu was executed for crime. Junchen memorialized and gained audience, claiming he had earlier reported Langye Wang Chong's rebellion but had been suppressed by Xu.
In the Tianshou era Xu was executed for crime. Junchen memorialized and gained audience, claiming he had earlier reported the rebellion of Chong, Prince of Langye, but had been suppressed by Xu.
瑯邪王沖 is Li Chong, Prince of Langye.
He was appointed Left Censor Director; inside and outside the court everyone held his breath, communicating only by glances.
He was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left Tribunal; inside and outside the court everyone held his breath, communicating only by glances.
左臺御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief.

The Empress sent Attendant Palace Gentleman Zhou Chen to inspect. He hastily lent Renjie sash and belt and had him stand in the west wing. Chen feared Junchen, looked eastward, murmured assent, and left — no one dared question further.

The Empress sent Palace Receptionist Zhou Lin to inspect. He hastily lent Renjie sash and belt and had him stand in the west wing. Lin feared Junchen, looked eastward, murmured assent, and left — no one dared question further.
通事舍人 is palace receptionist; 綝 is read Lin. 綝 is read Lin.

In the Changshou era he was again appointed Palace Court Director, then demoted to Tongzhou military adjutant for corruption. Violent and unrestrained as ever, he seized a colleague's wife and humiliated her mother as well.

In the Changshou era he was again appointed Assistant of the Palace Administration, then demoted to Tongzhou military adjutant for corruption. Violent and unrestrained as ever, he seized a colleague's wife and humiliated her mother as well.
殿中丞 is assistant of the Palace Administration.
He was soon recalled as Captain of He Gong, promoted to Luoyang Magistrate, advanced to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and granted ten slaves from the Directorate of Agriculture.

He was soon recalled as Commandant of Hegong County, promoted to Luoyang Magistrate, advanced to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and granted ten slaves from the Directorate of Agriculture.
合宮尉 is the commandant of Hegong county.

Because his household lacked a male attendant, hearing that the Tibetan chieftain Ashina Huseluo had a maid skilled in song and dance, he had his faction accuse her of plotting rebellion so he could seize the maid. Several dozen tribal chieftains cut their ears and scarred their faces to plead innocence — and only barely obtained her release.

Because his household lacked a male attendant, hearing that the Tibetan chieftain Ashina Huseluo had a maid skilled in song and dance, he had his faction accuse her of plotting rebellion so he could seize the maid. Several dozen tribal chieftains cut their ears and scarred their faces to plead innocence — and only then was Huseluo cleared.
僅得解 means Huseluo was barely cleared.
Qi Lianyao and others had a separate conspiracy; Ji Xu reported it to Junchen, who exterminated several dozen clans.
Qilian Yao and others had a separate conspiracy; Ji Xu reported it to Junchen, who exterminated several dozen clans.
綦連 is a two-character surname.
Wang Qingzhou's daughter had married Duan Jian and was beautiful; Junchen forged an edict and forcibly took her as his wife.
Wang Qingshen's daughter had married Duan Jian and was beautiful; Junchen forged an edict and forcibly took her as his wife.

Lai Junchen cast off his wife and forcibly married the daughter of Wang Qingshou of Taiyuan. Sizhi likewise sought to marry the daughter of Li Ziyi of Zhao Commandery. When the matter reached the chancellor Li Zhaode, he objected: "Junchen already shamed the realm by seizing Qingshou's daughter — must this slave do the same?"

Lai Junchen cast off his wife and forcibly married the daughter of Wang Qingshen of Taiyuan. Sizhi likewise sought to marry the daughter of Li Ziyi of Zhao Commandery. When the matter reached the chancellor Li Zhaode, he objected: "Junchen already shamed the realm by seizing Qingshen's daughter — must this slave do the same?"
慶詵 is read Qingshen. 慶詵 is read Qingshen.

Knowing that the officials dared not denounce him, Junchen then harbored other designs. He often compared himself to Shi Le and planned to accuse the Crown Prince and Prince of Luling of conspiring with the southern and northern yamen — thereby winning free rein for himself.

Knowing that the officials dared not denounce him, Junchen then harbored other designs. He often compared himself to Shi Le and planned to accuse the Imperial Heir and the Prince of Luling of conspiring with the southern and northern yamen — thereby winning free rein for himself.
皇嗣 is the Imperial Heir (Li Dan), not a crown prince.

In the first year of Yongchang, Zixun memorialized and was promoted to Left Censor Investigating Censor. Without learning and coarse in speech, he was relied on by the Empress to handle cases, mostly following her wishes; hence she granted him the surname Wu and the style Jiachén.

In the first year of Yongchang, Zixun memorialized and was promoted to Investigating Censor of the Left Tribunal. Without learning and coarse in speech, he was relied on by the Empress to handle cases, mostly following her wishes; hence she granted him the surname Wu and the style Jiachen.
左臺監察御史 is an investigating censor of the Left Tribunal. 家臣 romanized without diacritic.

After falsely accusing Ya Prefecture Governor Liu Xingshi and his brothers of rebellion and having them executed, he dug up and destroyed their ancestral tombs and was promoted to General of Irregular Command.
After falsely accusing Yazhou Prefect Liu Xingshi and his brothers of rebellion and having them executed, he dug up and destroyed their ancestral tombs and was promoted to Mobile Corps General.
雅州刺史 is the prefect of Yazhou. 遊擊將軍 is the Mobile Corps General rank.

When Heng Prefecture Governor Pei Zhen whipped his clerks, they nursed a grudge and taught Sizhi to accuse Prince Shu Yuanming of plotting rebellion with Zhen. The case was handed to Zhou Xing for interrogation; entire clans were wiped out, and Sizhi was made General of Irregular Command.

When Heng Prefecture Governor Pei Zhen whipped his clerks, they nursed a grudge and taught Sizhi to accuse Yuanming, Prince of Shu, of plotting rebellion with Zhen. The case was handed to Zhou Xing for interrogation; entire clans were wiped out, and Sizhi was made Mobile Corps General.
遊擊將軍 is the Mobile Corps General rank. 舒王元名 is Li Yuanming, Prince of Shu.
Wang Hongyi was a native of Hengshui in Ji Prefecture. Through secret denunciations he rose to General of Irregular Command and then to Left Censor, vying with Lai Junchen in brutality.

Wang Hongyi was a native of Hengshui in Ji Prefecture. Through secret denunciations he rose to Mobile Corps General and then to Attendant Censor of the Left Tribunal, vying with Lai Junchen in brutality.
遊擊將軍 is the Mobile Corps General rank. 左臺侍御史 is an attendant censor of the Left Tribunal.

Zhou Xing had studied law from youth, rose from Clerk of the Masters of Writing to Vice Minister of the Autumn Office, repeatedly decided specially designated cases in language harsh and severe, and wantonly killed several thousand men.

Zhou Xing had studied law from youth, rose from clerk of the Department of State Affairs to Vice Minister of the Autumn Office, repeatedly decided specially designated cases in language harsh and severe, and wantonly killed several thousand men.
尚書史 is a clerk of the Department of State Affairs.
When Empress Wu seized power, she appointed him Left Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing; he memorialized requesting removal from the Tang imperial clan register.
When Empress Wu seized power, she appointed him Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; he memorialized asking that the Tang imperial house be struck from the clan register.
尚書左丞; 請去唐宗正屬籍 targets the Tang house’s registration.

When Emperor Gaozong died, the Empress had Crown Prince Zhanghuai killed in Bazhou and pinned the blame on Shenji, who was demoted to prefect of Die Prefecture but soon restored. He aided Lai Junchen and others in brutal prosecutions and thus won the Empress's favor.

When Emperor Gaozong died, the Empress had Crown Prince Zhanghuai killed in Bazhou and pinned the blame on Shenji, who was demoted to prefect of Diezhou but soon restored. He aided Lai Junchen and others in brutal prosecutions and thus won the Empress's favor.

During Tianshou he was promoted to Left Censor. Yuanli coached him again: "The Empress will see you have no house and will surely grant you a mansion seized from some rebel. Decline: 'I detest traitors and do not wish to live where they lived.'"

During Tianshou he was promoted to Attendant Censor of the Left Tribunal. Yuanli coached him again: "The Empress will see you have no house and will surely grant you a mansion seized from some rebel. Decline: 'I detest traitors and do not wish to live where they lived.'"
左臺侍御史 is an attendant censor of the Left Tribunal.

Sizhi spoke with a vulgar accent that people parodied for laughs. Censor Huo Xiankai repeatedly ridiculed him; Sizhi complained to the Empress, who scolded Xiankai: "I have appointed him — what is there to mock?"

Sizhi spoke with a vulgar accent that people parodied for laughs. Attendant Censor Huo Xiankai repeatedly ridiculed him; Sizhi complained to the Empress, who scolded Xiankai: "I have appointed him — what is there to mock?"

He forged an edict summoning himself back, but the fraud was discovered. Censor Hu Yuanli happened to be traveling to Lingnan and stopped at Xiang Prefecture to investigate. Cornered, Hongyi said, "We're birds of a feather — why hound me so?"

He forged an edict summoning himself back, but the fraud was discovered. Attendant Censor Hu Yuanli happened to be traveling to Lingnan and stopped at Xiang Prefecture to investigate. Cornered, Hongyi said, "We're birds of a feather — why hound me so?"
侍御史 is an attendant censor.
Yuanli snapped, "When I was warden in Luoyang, you were a censor;
Yuanli snapped, "When I was commandant of Luoyang, you were a censor;
尉洛陽 means serving as commandant of Luoyang.

Guo Hongba was a native of Tong'an in Shu Prefecture and served as assistant magistrate of Ningling. During Tianshou he was nominated through the Gerevolution channel and gained an audience, declaring: "When we marched against Xu Jingye, I vowed to flay his sinews, eat his flesh, drink his blood, and suck out his marrow."

Guo Hongba was a native of Tong'an in Shu Prefecture and served as assistant magistrate of Ningling. During Tianshou he was nominated as a supporter of the dynastic revolution and gained an audience, declaring: "When we marched against Xu Jingye, I vowed to flay his sinews, eat his flesh, drink his blood, and suck out his marrow."
革命舉 is a recommendation for those backing the Zhou revolution.
The Empress was delighted and made him Left Investigating Censor — nicknamed the 'Four-His Censor' for his four vows of sinew, flesh, blood, and marrow.
The Empress was delighted and made him Investigating Censor of the Left Tribunal — nicknamed the 'Four-His Censor' for his four vows of sinew, flesh, blood, and marrow.
左臺監察御史 is an investigating censor of the Left Tribunal.

Promoted again to Right Censor. When Chief Minister Wei Yuanzhong fell ill, his staff came to call; Hongba arrived last, feigning deep concern. He asked to examine Yuanzhong's urine and stool, dipped his finger and tasted it, and declared with satisfaction, "Sweet means no recovery — this is bitter, so he will get well."

Promoted again to Attendant Censor of the Right Tribunal. When Censor-in-Chief Wei Yuanzhong fell ill, his staff came to call; Hongba arrived last, feigning deep concern. He asked to examine Yuanzhong's urine and stool, dipped his finger and tasted it, and declared with satisfaction, "Sweet means no recovery — this is bitter, so he will get well."
右臺侍御史 is an attendant censor of the Right Tribunal. 大夫 here is the Censor-in-Chief heading the tribunal.
Once while investigating Fang Prefecture Governor Li Sizheng, he tortured the man to death.
Once while investigating Fangzhou Prefect Li Sizheng, he tortured the man to death.
芳州刺史 is the prefect of Fangzhou.
The Empress repeatedly saw Sizheng's ghost and ordered her household to perform rites of expiation.
Afterward Hongba repeatedly saw Sizheng's ghost and ordered his household to perform rites of expiation.
后 here is 後 (afterward); the ghost haunts Guo Hongba, not the Empress.
Soon she saw Sizheng ride up at the head of dozens of horsemen crying, "You framed me unjustly — now I come for you!"
Soon he saw Sizheng ride up at the head of dozens of horsemen crying, "You framed me unjustly — now I come for you!"
The subject is Guo Hongba, who then kills himself.
After the executions Shaozhi swaggered with arrogant satisfaction, drawing everyone's gaze; he was promoted to Left Censor.
After the executions Shaozhi swaggered with arrogant satisfaction, drawing everyone's gaze; he was promoted to Attendant Censor of the Left Tribunal.
左臺侍御史 is an attendant censor of the Left Tribunal.
The case was proved — five million in bribes; by law he should die. Empress Wei's younger sister interceded, so the sentence was reduced to exile as assistant magistrate of Qiongshan.
The case was proved — five million in bribes; by law he should die. Empress Wei's younger sister interceded, so the sentence was reduced to demotion to commandant of Qiongshan.
貶瓊山尉 is demotion to commandant of Qiongshan County.
Under Empress Wu he was transferred to be assistant magistrate of Qiantang. Fishing was banned at the time, and the prefect ate only vegetables.
Under Empress Wu he was transferred to be commandant of Qiantang. Fishing was banned at the time, and the prefect ate only vegetables.
錢塘尉 is commandant of Qiantang County.
At the start of Shenlong he rose to censor, currying favor with the powerful. The Five Princes despised him and had him posted out as military administrator of Jia Prefecture.
At the start of Shenlong he rose to attendant censor, currying favor with the powerful. The Five Princes despised him and had him posted out as military administrator of Jia Prefecture.
侍御史 is an attendant censor.
Acting as Right Censor, he raced beyond the mountains and forged orders to kill Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, and Yuan Shuji. On his return he was made Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

Acting as Attendant Censor of the Right Tribunal, he raced beyond the mountains and forged orders to kill Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, and Yuan Shuji. On his return he was made Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Left Tribunal.
攝右臺侍御史 is acting attendant censor of the Right Tribunal. 左臺御史中丞 is vice censor-in-chief of the Left Tribunal.
At the start of Xiantian he became regional inspector of Guang Prefecture.
At the start of Xiantian he became area commander-in-chief of Guangzhou.
廣州都督 is the area commander-in-chief of Guangzhou.
Liu was saved only because Gui Prefecture inspector Wang Jun protected him.
Liu was saved only because Guizhou area commander-in-chief Wang Jun protected him.
桂州都督 is the area commander-in-chief of Guizhou.

In early Kaiyuan an edict declared: "Lizhen, Fu Prefecture Governor Pei Tan, Rao Prefecture Governor Pei Qizhen, Court of Review Assessor Zhang Sijing, Wang Chengben, Huayuan Magistrate Kang Wei, Censor Feng Xunxing, and the judicial officers Zhang Shengzhi, Liu Hui, Yang Yun, Wei Sui, Zhong Zhongshi, Gongsun Yan, and Lian Prefecture Military Administrator Zhong Silian are all cruel officials and shall never again be employed."

In early Kaiyuan an edict declared: "Lizhen, Huazhou Prefect Pei Tan, Raozhou Prefect Pei Qizhen, Court of Review Assessor Zhang Sijing, Wang Chengben, Huayuan Magistrate Kang Wei, Attendant Censor Feng Xunxing, and the judicial officers Zhang Shengzhi, Liu Hui, Yang Yun, Wei Suizhong, Gongsun Yan, and Lian Prefecture Military Administrator Zhong Silian are all cruel officials and shall never again be employed."
滑州刺史 is the prefect of Huazhou; 饒州刺史 the prefect of Raozhou. 侍御史 is attendant censor; 衛遂忠 is one name (Wei Suizhong), and no Zhong Zhongshi appears in the source.

Lizhen was an old partisan of Empress Wu's faction who cut down Huan and Jing. Since Your Majesty took the throne, reformed government, stripped such men of rank, and banished them to the wilderness — fulfilling the realm's hopes — men of principle still thought the penalties too light.

Lizhen was an old partisan of Zong Chuke and Wu Sansi who cut down Huan Yanfan and Jing Hui. Since Your Majesty took the throne, reformed government, stripped such men of rank, and banished them to the wilderness — fulfilling the realm's hopes — men of principle still thought the penalties too light.
宗、武 are Zong Chuke and Wu Sansi; 桓、敬 are Huan Yanfan and Jing Hui.
Before long Lizhen was again made regional inspector of Qian Prefecture and given the rank of Grand Master of Palace Leisure.
Before long Lizhen was again made area commander-in-chief of Qianzhou and given the rank of Grand Master of Palace Leisure.
黔州都督 is the area commander-in-chief of Qianzhou.
Left Censor Zhai Zhang impeached Rang for speaking out of turn without waiting for the proper escort and asked that the law be applied.
Attendant Censor of the Left Tribunal Zhai Zhang impeached Rang for speaking out of turn without waiting for the proper escort and asked that the law be applied.
左臺侍御史 is an attendant censor of the Left Tribunal.

Under Kaiyuan there were also Luoyang Assistant Magistrate Wang Jun and Henan Assistant Director Yan Anzhi, who beat prisoners for fear they might not die. When a swelling burst they beat them again until blood ran — and only then were they satisfied.

Under Kaiyuan there were also Luoyang commandant Wang Jun and Henan assistant magistrate Yan Anzhi, who beat prisoners for fear they might not die. When a swelling burst they beat them again until blood ran — and only then were they satisfied.
洛陽尉 is commandant of Luoyang; 河南丞 is assistant magistrate of Henan County.
Wang Xu was the grandson of Chief Minister Wang Gui of the Zhenguan era.
Wang Xu was the grandson of Palace Attendant Wang Gui of the Zhenguan era.
侍中 is the Palace Attendant heading the Chancellery.
At the start of Shenlong he served as army records officer of Yan Prefecture.
At the start of Shenlong he served as administrator of the Military Bureau of Yanzhou.
兗州兵曹參軍 is the military-bureau administrator of Yanzhou.

When Zhang Yizhi was executed, his elder brother Changyi had already been demoted to assistant magistrate of Qianfeng. Xu promptly beheaded him and sent the head to the Eastern Capital, and was transferred to army records officer of Bing Prefecture.

When Zhang Yizhi was executed, his elder brother Changyi had already been demoted to commandant of Qianfeng. Xu promptly beheaded him and sent the head to the Eastern Capital, and was transferred to army records officer of Bing Prefecture.
乾封尉 is the commandant of Qianfeng County.

Chief Administrator Zhou Rengui was a partisan of Empress Wei. When Emperor Xuanzong quelled the palace crisis an edict ordered Zhou's execution; Xu did not wait for confirmation, beheaded him, and brought the head to the capital. He rose through repeated promotions to Left Censor.

Chief Administrator Zhou Rengui was a partisan of Empress Wei. When Emperor Xuanzong quelled the palace crisis an edict ordered Zhou's execution; Xu did not wait for confirmation, beheaded him, and brought the head to the capital. He rose through repeated promotions to Attendant Censor of the Left Tribunal.
左臺侍御史 is an attendant censor of the Left Tribunal.
Xu feuded with Chief Minister Li Jie, and they denounced each other relentlessly until Jie was dismissed as prefect of Qu Prefecture. Xu then grew even more overbearing and indulged his cruelty.
Xu feuded with Censor-in-Chief Li Jie, and they denounced each other relentlessly until Jie was dismissed as prefect of Qu Prefecture. Xu then grew even more overbearing and indulged his cruelty.
大夫 here is the Censor-in-Chief.

Xiqiao sent a slave to work as a censorate hireling for Xu, who unknowingly favored him. The slave recorded thousands of Xu's corrupt dealings and showed them to Xiqiao. Xiqiao wept and appealed to the prince, who reported it to the throne. An investigation found untold illicit gains; Xu was demoted to assistant magistrate of Longchuan and died of rage.

Xiqiao sent a slave to work as a censorate hireling for Xu, who unknowingly favored him. The slave recorded thousands of Xu's corrupt dealings and showed them to Xiqiao. Xiqiao wept and appealed to the prince, who reported it to the throne. An investigation found untold illicit gains; Xu was demoted to commandant of Longchuan and died of rage.
龍川尉 is the commandant of Longchuan County.

Xiyi wrote indictments of deep cruelty. His uncle Zhang Boji, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Linfu's son-in-law, rose from chief clerk of the censorate to Palace Censor through the marriage tie.

Xiyi wrote indictments of deep cruelty. His uncle Zhang Boji, Vice Director of the Court of State Ceremonial and Linfu's son-in-law, rose from chief clerk of the censorate to Palace Censor through the marriage tie.
鴻臚少卿 is the vice director of the Court of State Ceremonial.
At first Wen, through a eunuch, presented a daughter he had by Wu Jing as consort to Prince Sheng and was promoted to capital corps officer of Jingzhao.
At first Wen, through a eunuch, presented the daughter of Wu Jingyi, born of his own sister, as consort to Prince Sheng and was promoted to administrator of the Works Bureau of Jingzhao.
其出武敬一女 is Wu Jingyi’s daughter by Wen’s sister; 士曹參軍 is the works-bureau administrator.
Linfu sought to undermine the crown prince. Left Martial Guard Officer Liu Ji opportunistically exposed secret affairs of Consort Du Liangdi's household.

Linfu sought to undermine the crown prince. Liu Ji, administrator of the Left Valiant Guard, seized the chance to expose secret affairs of the household of the crown prince’s consort Du (liangdi rank).
左驍衛參軍 is the administrator of the Left Valiant Guard; 良娣 is a consort rank, not a name.
Wen was furious and prompted Ji to implicate She and Heir Apparent Prince Ju of Guo — all were driven out and banished.
Wen was furious and prompted Ji to implicate She and Ju, the hereditary Prince of Guo, — all were driven out and banished.
嗣虢王巨 is Li Ju, who inherited the Guo princedom.
When his mother died he resigned mourning, and Lushan recommended him as prefect of Wei Commandery.
When his mother died he left office to mourn, and Lushan recommended him as prefect of Wei Commandery.
以母喪解 means leaving office for mourning.
The next year Wen was again convicted of taking bribes and seizing commoners' horses and was demoted to assistant magistrate of Duanxi.
The next year Wen was again convicted of taking bribes and seizing commoners' horses and was demoted to commandant of Duanxi.
端溪尉 is the commandant of Duanxi County.

When Heir Prince of Qi Wang Zhen plotted rebellion, an edict ordered Yu to investigate thoroughly.
